title: Mechanics Bancorp Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Cash Dividend
body_markdown:
Friday, November 20, 2026


WALNUT CREEK, Calif. — Mechanics Bancorp (Nasdaq: MCHB) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.43 per share of Class A common stock and $4.30 per share of Class B common stock, each payable on December 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 30, 2026.


**About Mechanics Bancorp**


Mechanics Bancorp is headquartered in Walnut Creek, Calif., and is the financial holding company of Mechanics Bank, a full-service, FDIC-insured bank with $20.9 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, and 166 branches across California, Oregon, Washington and Hawaii. Founded in 1905 to help families, businesses and communities prosper, Mechanics Bank offers a wide range of products and services in consumer and business banking, commercial lending, cash management services, private banking, and comprehensive wealth management and trust services.


To learn more, visit[www.MechanicsBank.com](https://www.mechanicsbank.com/) .
